project_structure.description: Agentic software factory template providing Cadence (Temporal) Python workflows, a skill activity harness, promptfoo-based evaluations, and a project wiki (vault) for decisions and runbooks.

subprojects.description: Shared utilities: preflight, target repository resolution, scoped path validation, mutation lease, skill/activity harness, workflow logging.
Cadence workflow and activities for the EDD quality-ratchet refinement loop: initialize, plan, do, validate, check, commit, regression handling, finalize.
Cadence workflow that extracts and analyzes user story intent using skill activities.
Cadence workflow that designs story implementations using skill activities.
promptfoo evaluation suites for skill and workflow quality gating.

decisions.why: Defines the EDD loop's iteration/token/regression budgets and the deterministic comparison/acceptance rules that the new scope enforcement must integrate with without disturbing.
Establishes target repository discovery, clean-worktree preflight, and mutation-lease conventions that scope enforcement will rely on for clean resets and lease release.
Describes the while-loop structure in workflow.py where out-of-scope rejections currently exit quietly and need to be converted to exception-driven terminalization.
Documents the exception-driven finalize path in workflow.py that should be reused to guarantee lease release when an out-of-scope modification is detected.

target_architecture.why: Runbook and current-implementation log for the EDD refinement workflow, including ProgressRecord v5 schema, iteration start baseline threading, and the activities (initialize_run, edd_plan, edd_do, validate_candidate, finalize_run) that the scope enforcement must touch.

components.why: Resolves target repository context and validates scoped_paths for containment inside the repo, but the resolved list is not returned or attached to PreflightResult.
Existing ScopedPathValidator checks that a single path is inside the repo root; it is the base primitive for building a list-based PathScopeChecker.
Creates the v5 progress record and writes refinement.yaml, but does not read or persist the EddRefinementInput modification_scope.
EddPlanRunner invokes the edd-plan skill and builds a PlanningResult from plan.json, but does not validate intended_files against the authorized modification_scope before allowing edd_do to run.
Invokes the edd-do skill and measures the actual diff (git diff --name-only) and diff hash, providing the ground-truth changed_files for a scope check.

Checks changed_files against planning['intended_files'] and reports 'out_of_scope', but has no access to the authorized modification_scope and no distinction between plan-out-of-scope and diff-out-of-scope.
Deterministic Check step that runs the evaluation and writes check.json; scope violations should not reach this step.
Restores the worktree only when a best_accepted_state exists and releases the mutation lease; it must also reset to starting_revision when no candidate was accepted.

The main EddRefinementWorkflow loop quietly returns when validate_candidate status is not 'scope_valid', bypassing finalize_run and lease release; needs to raise on out-of-scope to engage exception-driven finalize.
ProgressRecordSerializer.for_v5 defines the allowed field allow-list for progress.json; modification_scope must be added here to survive round-trip save/load.
Defines ExecutionResult, CandidateValidationResult, and UsageMetrics dataclasses; rejection_reasons and result shapes may need extension.

services.why: Registers EddRefinementWorkflow and all activity entrypoints; any new or renamed activity (e.g., a worktree-revert helper) must be wired here.

models.why: Domain models for candidate execution and validation results.
Progress record store and serializer that will carry the persisted modification_scope.

apis.why: Cadence workflow 'EddRefinementWorkflow' with get_candidate_status and get_regression_status queries.

tests.why: End-to-end workflow tests; currently only asserts query surface for out_of_scope candidate and does not verify finalize_run is invoked on scope violation.
ValidateCandidateActivity tests; currently cover intended_files vs changed_files mismatch but not authorized modification_scope.
Common utility tests, including the existing scoped path validator.
